retrievalProfile.description: A lo-fi, nostalgic aesthetic featuring a flash-lit childhood snapshot with bold, flat red typography overlaid on the top and bottom.
triggerTerms: bold red block lettering on photo

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition centered on a grainy, flash-lit photograph of a child in blue pajamas holding a toy against a backdrop of vertical white curtains. The image is framed by bold, sans-serif red text at the top and bottom, creating a DIY, nostalgic feel.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically against a repetitive curtain texture
High-contrast red text against muted, desaturated background tones
Flash-lit foreground subject with soft, dark shadows on the floor
Grainy film texture unifying the image and text elements
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and slight color desaturation

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body child subject centered, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The child's face and the toy train held in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top red text, moves down to the subject's face, then to the toy, and finally to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Vertical curtain folds provide a textured but neutral negative space on the left and right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted teal and off-white (pajamas and curtains)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black and white (advisory label in corner)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the photograph contrasted with high-value, high-saturation red text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in different positions for consistency.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory style label in bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold nature of the display text.
Provides a similar classic, bold sans-serif feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, 1970s-style flash photograph of a toddler in teal pajamas holding a toy train, standing in front of white vertical curtains.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, uppercase red sans-serif text at the top left and bottom center. Add a black and white rectangular advisory label in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the photo grainy and flash-lit?
Is the text bold red and uppercase?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the child
Exact brand logos on the toy
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the grain doesn't obscure the text legibility.
Verify the red color is vibrant against the muted background.
Check that the flash shadow is consistent with the light source.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Snapshot + Bold Red Sans-Serif Overlay + Square Format
